title: MCP-Universe RL: A Framework for Training MCP Tool-Use Agents via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.22167v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective way to improve the tool-use ability of large language models (LLMs), but most existing RL frameworks stop at the policy update. For every new domain, the user is left with two hard systems problems: standing up an isolated environment for each of hundreds of concurrent trajectories and connecting it to training, and scheduling the rollout so that the GPU stays busy across long, multi-turn episodes that spend much of their time stalled on slow tool calls. We present MCP-Universe RL (MCP-U RL), an open-source framework that takes over both. It uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as the interface to the environment, so any tool already exposed as an MCP server plugs into training with no RL-specific integration code. translated_title: MCP-Universe RL：一种通过强化学习训练MCP工具使用代理的框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22167v1 公告类型：新 摘要：强化学习（RL）已成为提升大型语言模型（LLMs）工具使用能力的有效方式，但大多数现有RL框架止步于策略更新。对于每个新领域，用户面临两个困难的系统问题：为数百个并发轨迹搭建隔离环境并将其连接到训练，以及调度轨迹回放以确保GPU在长时间、多轮次的回合中保持忙碌，而这些回合往往因缓慢的工具调用而停滞。我们提出了MCP-Universe RL（MCP-U RL），一个开源框架，负责处理这两个问题。它使用模型上下文协议（MCP）作为环境接口，因此任何已作为MCP服务器暴露的工具都可以无缝接入训练，无需特定的RL集成代码。它一次性构建两个缺失层，并在不同领域间重用：一个环境编排层，用于提供、隔离和回收MCP环境。
tldr: 该框架通过MCP协议统一环境接口，并构建可复用的环境编排与调度层，解决了RL训练中工具使用代理的环境隔离和GPU利用问题。
en_tdlr: This framework unifies the environment interface via MCP and builds reusable orchestration and scheduling layers, addressing environment isolation and GPU utilization issues in RL training for tool-use agents.
